summary: Ludwigsburg University of Education's master's in International Education Management (INEMA) is a DAAD development-related course with six DAAD scholarship places. It is for graduates with two years of work in education or development cooperation. Applications for the 2027 intake open on 2 January and close on 15 March 2027.
meta_title: PH Ludwigsburg International Education Management: DAAD 2027
meta_description: PH Ludwigsburg's International Education Management master's has six DAAD scholarships for education professionals. Apply 2 January to 15 March 2027.
covers: A DAAD scholarship for six students. Our DAAD page explains what DAAD development scholarships pay.
eligibility: A bachelor's or equivalent with an above-average final grade, normally no more than six years old.
Two years of related work in education or development cooperation after your bachelor's.
English at B2 shown by IELTS, TOEFL or Duolingo. A letter saying you were taught in English is not enough.
Nationality of a country on DAAD's development list.
how_to_apply: Upload your passport, a dated Europass CV, a signed motivation letter of 1,150 words, your school leaving certificate, degree certificates and transcripts, proof of two years' employment (signed, stamped and dated), your English test and a recommendation from your current employer.
DAAD applicants add the DAAD form and the EPOS checklist. Documents not in English or German need certified translations.
watch_out: Only six DAAD places, so the competition is strong.
Your employer's recommendation must be recent.
Self-funded applicants use the same window.

faq.q: When can I apply to INEMA for 2027?
faq.a: From 2 January to 15 March 2027, for DAAD and self-funded applicants.

faq.q: How many DAAD scholarships does INEMA have?

faq.a: Yes: two years in education or development cooperation after your bachelor's.
